text_block_list.text: The meeting with the representatives of the Satono Group—Satono Diamond's parents—was held in the reserved student council room.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Father, Mother. This is the Trainer I have chosen!
They possess an incredible keenness of eye. So please, give us your approval—!

text_block_list.name: Dia's Father
text_block_list.text:
I understand how you feel, but we cannot grant our approval
without seeing their capabilities firsthand.

text_block_list.name: Dia's Father
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, I must ask you to undergo an examination.
Both you... and my daughter.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
And so, Satono-san, Trainer-san, I shall be your examiner.
One month from now, you will race against me to show just how far you can go.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Wait, McQueen-san is the examiner?!
The gap in our abilities seems far too immense... But are you both ready for the briefing?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
It cannot be helped. One simply does not defy your mother.
The distance will be "2,400 meters, just like the Japan Derby."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
A classic distance demanding not just a sharp turn of foot, but stamina and precise pacing.
Show me that you two are undeniably the right match for one another.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry... I was the one who asked for this,
and now it's come to this...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Um... would you rather not?
Take on McQueen-san together with me, that is.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
McQueen-san is... formidable... And with 2,400 meters full of
unknowns, earning her approval won't be easy.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yet I truly believe! You looked directly at my running without being
blinded by my family name... I can only truly shine by your side! So...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...! Will you lend your strength, your future, to Dia?
Everyone will understand in time. Please...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Are you... truly certain?
choice_data_list: Let's do it. And one day, we'll reach the very top.
Let's do it. And together, we'll reach the very top.

text_block_list.text:
Win a GⅠ and shine at the pinnacle of the Twinkle Series.
As our first step toward that goal, the two of us began running toward the trial.

text_block_list.name: Dia & Kitasan
text_block_list.text:
Yaaaaaaahhhhhhhh!!
Haaahhhhhhhh!!
Her best friend readily stepped forward to serve as the ideal training partner.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa... *gasp*... haa...! Kita-chan, one more lap!
Just one more...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
It's not enough... This is nowhere near enough...! A burst of speed alone
won't let me compete with McQueen-san over 2,400 meters...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Dia-chan... what incredible intensity...
S-Sure thing. Let's go again!
choice_data_list: Satono Diamond, run with composure and vary your pace!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes, Trainer! Please keep watching Dia,
learn more about me, and guide me forward!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...I want to become a true diamond! Recognized by Father, by Mother,
a diamond that shines throughout our family's history...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... *cough, cough*... haah...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Dia-chan... you're amazing... truly amazing...
Keeping up with the exact same routine as me, when stamina is my whole thing...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
But Trainer... she really can't go any further.
Dia-chan hasn't even had her debut yet...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
The reason we didn't debut together was because I developed faster...
Pushing her to my limits like this is just...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I can... I can still keep going, Trainer!!
If I'm falling short, it's simply because I haven't done enough...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
At this rate, I won't stand a chance against McQueen-san, right?
Winning would be out of the question, wouldn't it?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Please give me your honest assessment.
As things stand right now, what will happen?
choice_data_list: Honestly... as you are now, I don't think you can match her.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...I figured as much.

As her partner, I can't lie to her.
I offer a calm, realistic outlook.

Her opponent is one of Tracen Academy's premier stayers. With her current preparation,
running a strong 2,400-meter trial and earning approval will be a steep uphill battle.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...I want to walk the path of the Twinkle Series
with you, Trainer. I truly do.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Unless we overcome this hurdle together, neither my dream nor the Satono dream will come true...
And if so, what was I even born for...?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
So please, please, Trainer.
Train Dia. Help me earn McQueen-san's approval!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Stop, Dia-chan! You're going to hurt yourself!
Trainer, stop her!

Two colliding wills and a desperate cry... This is a pivotal crossroad.
I have to choose what to keep and what to sacrifice—and set our course.

Back to square one. The most important thing is deciding what comes first.
The greatest reason for joining hands with Satono Diamond is...
choice_data_list: ...Satono Diamond, there's something important we need to discuss.

text_block_list.text:
A few days after that fateful decision.
—The day of reckoning arrived.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
――?! Satono-san, you...
Covered in mud like that... can you even run properly?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
You appear quite focused, I see.
...Well, as long as you can run, it makes no difference to me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Show me on the turf just what you have honed and how far you have come.
Naturally, I shall not hold back in the slightest.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(I've done everything... everything I possibly could.
All that's left is—)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (To unleash it all against McQueen-san!)
